title: ShipScope feature-flag ingest, schemaVersion 2
description: Body of POST /api/flags/ingest (Authorization: Bearer <ingest token>). One message carries the state of one flag source's flags in one or more environments. Also checked by the server, beyond what this schema can express: each key/env pair at most once with one value, rollout only with state "partial", changedAt between 7 days ago and 5 minutes ahead, every env of observations listed in environments (when given), every flags[].key observed in the same message and listed once, and no key named __proto__, constructor or prototype. The guide is in ONBOARDING.md, "Sending feature flags".

complete.description: true (default): the message is the full state of this source in the covered environments, so flags it no longer lists there are marked removed. false: only changes, nothing is removed.

environments.description: The environments this message covers (default: those named in observations). With complete and an empty observations list, says the source has no flags left there.

changedBy.description: Who made the change, shown on the dashboard (default: the flag source's name).

observations.description: One value per flag and environment.

state.description: off, on, or partial (on for some users).

rollout.description: Percentage of users, only with state partial.

changedAt.description: When the value really changed (default: when ShipScope received it). An older value never replaces a newer one.

flags.description: Optional description and linked Jira issues of flags observed in this message.

flagKey.description: Case-sensitive; must match the key used in Jira when flags are linked there.

env.description: ShipScope's environments; the sender maps its own names (staging, production, ...) onto these.
